findings.claim: “The model reaches AUC 0.93 on the test set”

summary: Main issue is result integrity: the conclusion claims test AUC=0.93, but the executed notebook reports AUC_TEST=0.729. Methodology and execution are otherwise solid (proper stratified split before preprocessing via a Pipeline; fixed random_state; appropriate use of AUC on an imbalanced churn base). Conclusions overstate performance (“excellent”, “production-ready”) and ignore the very low recall at the 0.5 threshold (0.119), so the recommendation is not well-supported. Decision by rubric: REJECT (C3=1 due to critical metric mismatch).
